title: Sunday · Lot C
logline: The Datsun in Lot C, ten years on, in watercolor. The lot, the light pole, the security booth. The strip's first landscape of a parking lot.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a community-college parking lot in October rain, mostly empty, one rusted small car under a light pole. LOT C on a sign.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a nearly empty college parking lot in autumn rain with one rusted small car under a light pole and a sign, no people, no words

panels.name: Lot

panels.composition: Tier 2: the light pole's sodium glow in the rain, the car's roof beneath it.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a sodium parking-lot light glowing orange in rain above a wet car roof, no words

panels.name: Pole

panels.composition: Tier 3: the security booth, dark, the clipboard on its hook through the glass. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a small dark parking-lot security booth with a clipboard visible on a hook through its window, no words
image.notes: The 2001 guard's clipboard. He's gone; the clipboard isn't.
